title: Convict charges recoverable from other Governments
html:
Convict charges recoverable from other Governments

96. Other Governments are in some cases responsible for the cost of maintenance of convicts imprisoned in jails in the Uttar Pradesh for offences committed in this State or in other States. The jail officials should in each case communicate to the Accountant General any amount recoverable on this account, and the Accountant General will then see to its due recovery.
